reviews.review:
First impressions are: a chill train game.

I was looking for a train game that did not ask for 100$+ in dlcs and was not trying to make me run an actual train by flipping some handles and stuff. And this is a great game to just chillax. Got a delivery done, and it was nice, it was easy it was cool. Similar vibes to American Truck Simulator.

For me the game is only missing an ability to invert mouse directions and easier control of crane, I think crane controls were pretty rough in the demo version. I guess map scroll speed is a bit too low and some way to highlight locations relevant to the mission taken would be great. But these are small things in the end.

But as a whole, a great way to chill
reviews.developer_response:

I also sincerely appreciate your thoughtful feedback.
The points you mentioned make perfect sense, and I plan to improve these areas during the Early Access updates.

Your suggestions are extremely valuable and will help me make the experience more comfortable and intuitive for everyone.

Thank you again for your support.
I hope Physical Train continues to be a fun and relaxing place for you to spend time.

Wishing you many pleasant journeys through Chamland!
